action: Hand off the threat model + DREAD hit list to vuln-scan; scope its checks to the top-3 boundaries.
rationale: SimpleStoreAPI exposes a confidential user table behind an Express server with no documented row-level authorization. Spoofing (S1) and Information disclosure (I1) at the client-server boundary score DREAD 38 and 34 respectively. Two assumptions remain unverified: presence of a transit TLS terminator and rate-limit posture on /api/v1/profile.
key_findings: TM-001 (Spoofing): unauthenticated PUT on /api/v1/profile — DREAD sum 38
TM-002 (Information disclosure): confidential user table without row-level authz — DREAD sum 34
TM-003 (Tampering): unsigned session cookie traversing client-server boundary — DREAD sum 27
TM-004 (Elevation of privilege): admin and customer routes share a controller — DREAD sum 25
Two unverified assumptions logged in THREAT_MODEL.md (TLS terminator presence, /api/v1/profile rate-limit posture)
